summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, disclosing that BlackRock, Inc. crossed a threshold on July 28, 2026, increasing its holdings to 7.10% of voting rights (5.11% direct shares, 1.99% via financial instruments). The notification is a routine major-holdings disclosure under UK AIM Rules, not a special situation. No corporate action, deal terms, or strategic event is involved. The filing is purely informational regarding a passive stake change.
